title: oreostemma peirsonii
intro: Oreostemma peirsonii, commonly known as Peirson's Phacelia, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States. It is traditionally used as an herbal remedy for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Peirson's Phacelia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
